title: Readymix Holdings - proposed acquisition of the Elvin Business

body_sections.Summary: Readymix Holdings Pty Ltd proposed acquisition of the Elvin concrete and quarrying business
body_sections.Market definition: The relevant markets were considered to be pre-mixed concrete within a 80km radius of the Elvin concrete plants in Canberra, and the quarrying of sand within a localised area of the Elvin quarry.
body_sections.Competition analysis: See Public Competition Assessment below for competition analysis.
